2f30c54.summary: Builds the list of valid targets for a card's ability based on its targets-available counter, including heroes, mana-based targets, cemetery, filters, and selection limits.

2f30d2c.summary: Turns this card into a hero by setting its state, position and scale, and toggles ambush-dependent visuals.

2f30e94.summary: Plays the invoke animation and invoke sound cue when a card turns into a minion on the board.

2f30f48.summary: Hides the 2D card, shows the 3D body, and plays the invoke sound for a teleport-style minion summon.

2f31020.summary: Returns the time of the first animation event in the hand-to-board animation clip.

2f310d0.summary: Puts the card into deck state and sets its canvas sorting order from its deck index.

2f31104.summary: Sets the card to the in-deck state, positions it on the deck, and resets its collider size and offset.

2f31148.summary: Copies the deck reference object's local position, rotation and scale onto this card.

2f3120c.summary: Moves a minion to a new in-play position, tweening if needed, skipping when it is already there.

2f31730.summary: Moves an asset card to a new in-play position with an optional tween, optionally storing it as the permanent position.

2f31560.summary: Checks whether the card's rotation and local position already match the target position within a small tolerance.

2f31aa8.summary: Tweens a card in hand to a target position, rotation and scale, killing any previous tweens.

2f31db8.summary: Animates drawing a card from the deck into the hand with sound, scale, rotation and bounce-eased movement.

2f32374.summary: Finishes the draw animation by updating card visibility and rotating the card back with an InBack ease.

2f32670.summary: Puts the card into the mulligan kept or discarded state, parenting it to the mulligan anchor and resetting its collider.

2f326f8.summary: Destroys the mulligan selected and button frame objects on the card UI.

2f320c8.summary: Moves the card into the player's hand state, refreshing its UI and parenting it to the hand anchor, ignoring heroes.

2f2cbc4.summary: Each frame moves and rotates a charging card toward its attack target using lerp and camera conversion.

2f328e8.summary: Returns whether any active effect on the card is an enchantment of mutation type.

2f329f0.summary: Returns whether the card has the given non-cumulative mutation among its active effects.

2f32ae8.summary: Logs and sets the card's state.

2f32ce4.summary: Moves the card to the center of the screen with scale and move tweens, returning the total animation time.

2f330cc.summary: Sends the card to the cemetery: dissolves it, resets values, and adds it to the cemetery list unless it is ephemeral.

2f332d8.summary: Animates the card back into its deck with move, scale and rotation tweens, returning the total animation time.

2f33114.summary: Destroys the active in-play animation objects on the card UI and clears the list; decompiled output is mostly array helper garbage.

2f33818.summary: Toggles a card between kept and discarded during mulligan selection, or in replays shows the selected frame and plays a toggle sound.
